nodes.label: Stamped manifest files guard (#2015)
nodes.rationale: Only stamp semantic files that actually produced output; a detected file whose chunk failed or was omitted must stay unstamped so the next --update re-queues it, otherwise it is marked done and its content is lost forever.

nodes.label: Honesty Rules
nodes.rationale: Never invent an edge (use AMBIGUOUS if unsure); never skip the corpus check warning; always show token cost; never hide cohesion scores; never run HTML viz on >5000 nodes without warning — these constraints exist to keep the graph's audit trail honest and prevent silent data loss or misleading visualization.

nodes.label: Debounce mechanism (default 3s)
nodes.rationale: Waits until file activity stops before triggering a rebuild, so a wave of parallel agent writes doesn't trigger a rebuild per file.

nodes.label: EXTRACTED/INFERRED/AMBIGUOUS confidence rubric
nodes.rationale: Models follow discrete rubrics better than continuous ranges; the bimodal distribution observed in production (>50% at 0.5, >40% at 0.85+) shows range guidance is being collapsed to a binary, so fixed discrete values (0.95/0.85/0.75/0.65/0.55) replace a free continuous scale.

nodes.label: Node ID format rule ({stem}_{entity})
nodes.rationale: Using the full repo-relative path (every directory level, not just immediate parent) keeps same-named files in different directories distinct and matches the AST extractor's ID scheme; using only filename or immediate parent creates orphan ghost-duplicate nodes.

nodes.label: source_file verbatim rule
nodes.rationale: Keeps the full build and incremental --update on the same base, so build_merge's replace-on-re-extract matches the existing node instead of accumulating a duplicate.

nodes.label: Work memory outcome tags (useful/dead_end/corrected)
nodes.rationale: Closes a self-improving feedback loop: cited nodes marked useful become preferred sources, dead_end paths are skipped next time, and corrected answers store the right answer so future sessions learn from prior mistakes.

nodes.label: Whisper domain-hint prompt strategy
nodes.rationale: The agent itself composes a one-sentence domain hint from god node labels (no separate API call needed) and passes it to Whisper as the initial prompt to improve transcription accuracy for domain-specific vocabulary.

nodes.label: Replace-on-re-extract dedup fix (#1344/#1178)
nodes.rationale: prune_sources is only for genuinely deleted files; changed/re-extracted files are handled by build_merge dropping every source_file in new_chunks from the base before merge, so old/stale nodes don't survive without needing a separate dedup pass.

nodes.label: spawn_agent / wait_agent / close_agent mechanism
nodes.rationale: Codex has no Agent tool with disk-based chunk files; it collects agent results in memory via wait_agent/close_agent, so per-chunk success is judged by valid JSON output rather than a chunk file existing on disk, and requires multi_agent=true in ~/.codex/config.toml.
